title: 第18章 名为‘人生’这场游戏的作弊代码
novel_title: 我都天庭临时工了，才神话复苏？(鬼懿)
content_zh: 隔天清晨，阳光刺破云层，却没能带来丝毫暖意。电视机里正在循环播放着两条爆炸性新闻。【就在今晨两点，欧罗巴时间早六点，奥丁神像于斯堪的纳维亚半岛复苏，首位代行者已获得‘冈格尼尔’投影。】【同一时间，光明之神阿波罗神像降临，代行者信息保密，全球神力浓度再创新高。】叶凛坐在餐桌前，一边往嘴里塞着油条，一边刷着手机。屏幕上全是各种狂热的弹幕和清一色的“接接接”。夏晚晴正对着镜子整理她的那件黄色外卖马甲。经过一夜的沉淀，她身上的肌肉线条更加明显。原本宽松的工装裤，现在绷在她的大腿上，显出一种充满爆发力的美感。“别贫了。”夏晚晴把头盔夹在腋下，回头催促。“赶紧走，去晚了连站的地方都没有。”苏沐雪站在玄关换鞋。她今天穿了一件很低调的运动服，把那张惊艳的脸蛋藏在鸭舌帽的阴影里。但她的视线始终没有离开过叶凛。这个男人太淡定了。面对神王降临这种足以让全球震荡的消息，他的反应居然就这？这种超然物外的态度，要么是无知到了极点，要么就是……他早就预料到了这一切？苏沐雪更倾向于后者。因为整整一夜，她也缓过来了。夏晚晴那恐怖的身体变化，和他的按摩绝对脱不了干系。三人出了门，直奔学校操场。现在的操场，已经彻底变成了大型神话直播间。原本的足球场已经被铲平。三尊高达十米的巨型神像巍峨耸立。左边是手持铁锤的火神赫菲斯托斯。中间是俊美无铸、手抚竖琴的光明神阿波罗。右边则是独眼、肩停乌鸦的神王奥丁。那种来自高维生命的压迫感，让操场上数千名学生都安静得像是一群鹌鹑。空气中弥漫的神力强得让人呼吸困难。叶凛站在人群后方，伸手在鼻子前扇了扇。“这味儿太冲了。”“什么味？”夏晚晴吸了吸鼻子，“我怎么没闻到？”“老人味。”“一群活了几千年的老家伙，非要挤在人家学校操场上装什么顶级手办，格局小了。”叶凛把手插在兜里，甚至还打了个哈欠。周围几个虔诚祈祷的学生听到了，投来杀人般的视线。叶凛毫无自觉，甚至还回了一个“看什么看，没见过帅哥啊”的表情。苏沐雪默默地往旁边挪了一步。她不想被当成同伙。这家伙真是在别人的雷区里疯狂蹦迪。测试很快开始。流程简单粗暴：学生走上高台，把手放在神像前的水晶球上。亮了就是以后的人上人。不亮就是当牛做马的耗材。大部分人上去，水晶球连个屁都不放。偶尔有几个微弱亮起的，得到的也只是寥寥几声叹息。也只有那些亮了至少一半的，才会被旁边的军方或者财团代表带走，签下卖身契。直到那个身影出现。秦菲菲。她今天显然是精心打扮过的。脸上画着精致的全妆，穿着一条显身材的白色短裙，脚下踩着七厘米的高跟鞋。在这种严肃的场合，她硬是走出了一种红毯走秀的感觉。“一群土包子。”秦菲菲路过叶凛他们身边时，轻哼了一声。她昂着头，像是一只骄傲的孔雀，一步步走上高台。她选择了阿波罗的神像。毕竟比起那个又丑又瘸的铁匠和独眼的老头，帅气的阿波罗更符合她的审美。手掌触碰水晶球的瞬间。嗡！一道刺眼的金光冲天而起。虽然没有达到神明亲自降临赐福的程度，但这光芒的亮度，已经秒杀了之前所有的测试者。负责记录的军官手里的笔都掉了。“神力亲和度……85%！顶级信徒的苗子！”全场哗然。秦菲菲闭着眼，张开双臂，享受着这一刻。这就是她想要的人生。把所有人踩在脚下，成为世界的中心。就在这时，一个身穿金色软甲的年轻男人从贵宾席上站了起来。那一身金灿灿的铠甲在阳光下都能反光，不过没给人高贵的感觉。看起来就像是从某个劣质网游里走出来的氪金玩家。赵家大少，赵凌风。据说在神话复苏的第一天，他就靠着家族供奉的一件古希腊文物，强行觉醒了神力。如今已是二阶超凡者。赵凌风径直走到台上，向秦菲菲伸出了手。“秦小姐，赵家欢迎你的加入。”秦菲菲激动得脸都红了。她毫不犹豫地把手搭在赵凌风的手心，顺势挽住了对方的胳膊。人群里的目光都是羡慕嫉妒。除了一个咬牙切齿的胖子。也就是秦菲菲的第一任女朋友，王少。这一刻，秦菲菲觉得自已就是人生赢家。两人并在肩走下高台，人群自动分开一条路。秦菲菲没有直接离开。她带着赵凌风，径直走向了操场的角落。那里站着叶凛、夏晚晴和苏沐雪。秦菲菲停在距离叶凛三步远的地方。她微微抬起下巴，眼里满是报复后的快意。“叶凛，看清楚了吗？”“这就是我和你之间的差距。”秦菲菲指了指身后那尊光芒万丈的阿波罗神像，又指了指叶凛那一身廉价的地摊货。“你还是那个只能躲在角落里吐酸水的废物。”“而我，是神选中的人，已经站在了云端。”秦菲菲笑得很甜，声音却像是淬了毒。“现在就算你跪下来求我复合，我也只会觉得恶心。”“毕竟，人和神，是有生殖隔离的。”叶凛掏了掏耳朵。他甚至连眼皮都没抬一下。“我这人比较喜欢用手机记录生活。”“这位校花小姐，你也不想那天晚上发生的事情出现在你男朋友的手机里吧？”秦菲菲气得浑身发抖。她当然知道叶凛在说什么。但她没敢开口质疑叶凛是不是真的留下过什么证据。而秦菲菲身边那个金甲男人的视线，死死地盯着旁边的夏晚晴。那种眼神阴鸷得可怕。就像是猎人盯着一只曾经咬伤过他的野兽。充满了恶意和羞恼。“你惹他了？”叶凛用胳膊肘捅了捅快要气炸的夏晚晴。“借他高利贷没还？”夏晚晴正在气头上，被叶凛这一打岔，那股劲儿泄了一半。她瞪了赵凌风一眼，压低声音骂道：“昨天我送外卖去体育馆，这货当时正在跑道上开跑车装逼，一群人围着喊赵少牛逼。”“不过他好像没开过车，跟乌龟一样，我就超了他的车。”叶凛挑了挑眉：“就这？”夏晚晴挠了挠头，有点尴尬。“然后送完餐出来，看见他在测立定跳远。”“我当时急着接下一单，直接从沙坑上面跳过去了。”“也就比他多跳了两米吧。”“这孙子当时脸都绿了，非说我是吃了禁药，还要查我的外卖箱。”“我鸟都不鸟他。”叶凛：“……”苏沐雪：“……”画面感太强了。一个富二代在众目睽睽之下，被一个送外卖的路人在车技和体能上全方位碾压。难怪这货的眼神像是要吃人。赵凌风显然也听到了这边的嘀咕。他的脸皮抽动了一下，原本维持的高冷人设瞬间崩塌了。他往前走了一步，金色铠甲发出咔咔的摩擦声。一股属于二阶超凡者的威压毫不掩饰地朝着夏晚晴压了过来。“夏晚晴是吧？”“我知道你不服气。”“你一直觉得你那个什么‘华夏神系’才是最强的。”“可结果呢？”赵凌风指了指身后那三尊遮天蔽日的西方神像。“看看这天，看看这地。”“你们的华夏神在哪？”“听说你身体素质不错。”“正好，我的小队缺个肉盾。”“跪下，向菲菲道歉，我可以考虑给你一个当炮灰的机会。”周围的学生都吓得往后退。这可是二阶强者！在这个神话刚复苏的阶段，二阶就是无敌的代名词。那可是能媲美刚刚觉醒的代行者的实力！秦菲菲脸上的笑容更加灿烂了。她依偎在赵凌风身边，用一种胜利者的姿态看着夏晚晴。“听到了吗？”“这是赵少给你的恩赐。”“别指望你那些虚无缥缈的华夏神了，跪下求饶，或许还能活得像个人样。”夏晚晴的身体在颤抖。她想动手。哪怕打不过，哪怕会死，她也要把那张臭脸打烂。就在她准备冲上去拼命的时候。一只手按住了她的肩膀。那只手很凉，没什么力气，却稳稳地压住了她即将爆发的火山。“别急着送死。”叶凛的声音在她耳边响起。平淡，懒散，却给夏晚晴一种奇异的安抚力。“为了这种垃圾，不值得。”叶凛从兜里掏出一个皱皱巴巴的笔记本。那是他在蟠桃园值班时，用来打发时间的涂鸦本。上面还沾着一点没擦干净的油条渣。他把本子塞进夏晚晴的手里。“拿着。”叶凛挡在夏晚晴身前，隔绝了赵凌风那咄咄逼人的视线。他甚至没看赵凌风一眼。“这是什么？”夏晚晴愣住了。“名为‘人生’这场游戏的……作弊代码。”
content_en: The next morning, the sun broke through the clouds, but failed to bring any warmth.Two pieces of breaking news were playing on a loop on the TV.[At two o'clock this morning, six o'clock in the morning in Europa time, the statue of Odin resurrected in Scandinavia, and the first representative has obtained the 'Gangnir' projection.】【At the same time, the statue of Apollo, the god of light, descended, the agent's information was kept secret, and the concentration of global divine power hit a new high.] Ye Lin sat at the dining table, stuffing fried dough sticks into his mouth and scrolling through his phone.The screen is filled with all kinds of fanatical barrages and all kinds of "match after beat".Xia Wanqing was arranging her yellow takeout vest in front of the mirror.After a night of precipitation, the muscle lines on her body became more obvious.The originally loose overalls were now stretched on her thighs, showing an explosive beauty."Stop being poor." Xia Wanqing put her helmet under her arm and turned around to urge."Hurry up and leave. We're late and there's no place to stand." Su Muxue stood in the entrance hall and changed her shoes.She wore a very low-key sportswear today, hiding her stunning face in the shadow of a peaked cap.But her eyes never left Ye Lin.This man is too calm.Faced with the news that the God King has arrived, which is enough to shake the world, this is his reaction?This kind of detached attitude is either due to extreme ignorance, or...he has expected all this?Su Muxue prefers the latter.Because throughout the night, she also recovered.Xia Wanqing's terrifying physical changes were absolutely inseparable from his massage.The three of them went out and went straight to the school playground.The current playground has completely turned into a large-scale mythical live broadcast room.The original football field has been bulldozed.Three giant statues of ten meters high stand majestically.On the left is Hephaestus, the god of fire, holding a hammer.In the middle is the handsome Apollo, the god of light, holding a harp.On the right is the one-eyed god Odin with a raven on his shoulder.The oppressive feeling coming from higher-dimensional life made the thousands of students on the playground as quiet as a flock of quails.The divine power in the air was so strong that it was difficult to breathe.Ye Lin stood behind the crowd, stretched out his hand and slapped his nose."This smell is too strong." "What smell?" Xia Wanqing sniffed, "Why didn't I smell it?" "Old man smell." "A group of old guys who have lived for thousands of years have to crowd into other people's school playgrounds to install top-notch figurines. The layout is too small." Ye Lin put his hands in his pockets and even yawned.Several students who were praying devoutly heard it and cast murderous glances.Ye Lin had no self-consciousness and even responded with an expression like "What are you looking at? I've never seen a handsome guy before."Su Muxue silently moved a step aside.She didn't want to be considered an accomplice.This guy is really dancing wildly in other people's minefields.Testing begins soon.The process is simple and crude: students go up to the high platform and place their hands on the crystal ball in front of the statue of the god.The one who shines will be the master in the future.If it doesn't light up, it's just a consumable.Most people don't even fart in the crystal ball when they go up there.Occasionally, there were a few that lit up faintly, and only received a few sighs.Only those who were at least half lit up would be taken away by the military or consortium representatives next to them and signed a contract of sale.Until that figure appeared.Qin Feifei.She was clearly dressed up today.She had exquisite full makeup on her face, a white short skirt that showed off her figure, and seven-centimeter high heels.On such a serious occasion, she just walked out like a red carpet catwalk."A bunch of bumpkins." Qin Feifei snorted softly as she passed by Ye Lin and the others.She held her head high, like a proud peacock, and stepped onto the high platform step by step.She chose the statue of Apollo.After all, the handsome Apollo was more in line with her aesthetics than the ugly, lame blacksmith and the one-eyed old man.The moment when your palm touches the crystal ball.Buzz!A dazzling golden light shot into the sky.Although it did not reach the level where the gods personally came to give blessings, the brightness of this light had already killed all the previous testers in an instant.The officer in charge of recording dropped the pen in his hand."Divine affinity... 85%! The seed of a top believer!" The whole audience was in an uproar.Qin Feifei closed her eyes and opened her arms, enjoying the moment.This is the life she wants.Trample everyone under your feet and become the center of the world.At this moment, a young man wearing golden soft armor stood up from the VIP seat.The golden armor can reflect light in the sun, but it doesn't give people a noble feeling.It looks like a money-making player who came out of some inferior online game.The eldest son of the Zhao family, Zhao Lingfeng.It is said that on the first day after the revival of the myth, he forcibly awakened his divine power with the help of an ancient Greek artifact enshrined by his family.Now he is a second-level transcendent.Zhao Lingfeng walked straight to the stage and extended his hand to Qin Feifei."Miss Qin, the Zhao family welcomes you to join." Qin Feifei was so excited that her face turned red.She put her hand on Zhao Lingfeng's hand without hesitation and took the other person's arm.The eyes of the crowd were filled with envy and jealousy.Except for a fat man who gritted his teeth.That is Qin Feifei's first girlfriend, Mr. Wang.At this moment, Qin Feifei felt that she was the winner in life.The two walked off the high platform side by side, and the crowd automatically separated into a path.Qin Feifei did not leave directly.She led Zhao Lingfeng straight to the corner of the playground.Standing there were Ye Lin, Xia Wanqing and Su Muxue.Qin Feifei stopped three steps away from Ye Lin.She raised her chin slightly, her eyes filled with the joy of revenge."Ye Lin, do you see clearly?" "This is the gap between you and me." Qin Feifei pointed at the radiant Apollo statue behind her, and then pointed at Ye Lin's cheap street clothes."You are still the loser who can only hide in the corner and vomit acid water." "And I, the person chosen by God, am already standing in the clouds." Qin Feifei smiled sweetly, but her voice seemed to be quenched with poison."Even if you kneel down and beg me to get back together now, I will only feel disgusted." "After all, there is reproductive isolation between humans and gods." Ye Lin took out his ears.He didn't even raise his eyelids."I prefer to use my mobile phone to record my life." "This school beauty, you don't want what happened that night to appear on your boyfriend's mobile phone, right?" Qin Feifei was so angry that she was shaking all over.Of course she knew what Ye Lin was talking about.But she didn't dare to question whether Ye Lin really left any evidence.The man in golden armor next to Qin Feifei was staring at Xia Wanqing next to her.That look in his eyes was terrifyingly sinister.Like a hunter staring at a wild beast that has bitten him.Full of malice and shame."Did you offend him?" Ye Lin used his elbow to poke Xia Wanqing, who was about to explode with anger."You borrowed a usurious loan from him and haven't you paid it back?" Xia Wanqing was furious, but when Ye Lin interrupted her, half of her energy was gone.She glared at Zhao Lingfeng and cursed in a lowered voice: "Yesterday I was delivering food to the gym. This guy was driving a sports car on the track to show off. A group of people gathered around and called Mr. Zhao awesome." "But he didn't seem to have driven a car before. He was like a turtle, so I overtook his car." Ye Lin raised an eyebrow: "That's it?" Xia Wanqing scratched her head, a little embarrassed."Then I came out after delivering the meal and saw him measuring the standing long jump." "I was in a hurry to take the next order and jumped directly over the sand pit." "I only jumped two meters more than him." "The grandson's face turned green at the time. He must have said that I had taken banned drugs, and he had to check my takeout box." "I don't like him." Ye Lin: "..." Su Muxue: "..." The image is too strong.In full view of the public, a rich second generation was crushed by a passerby delivering food, both in terms of driving skills and physical fitness.No wonder this guy's eyes look like he wants to eat people.Zhao Lingfeng obviously heard the mutterings here.His face twitched, and the aloof persona he had maintained collapsed instantly.He took a step forward, and the golden armor made a clicking sound.A pressure belonging to a second-level transcendent pressed towards Xia Wanqing without concealment."Xia Wanqing, right?" "I know you're not convinced." "You always thought that your 'Chinese God Line' was the strongest." "But what's the result?" Zhao Lingfeng pointed at the three Western statues behind him that covered the sky and the sun."Look at this day, look at this land." "Where is your Chinese god?" "I heard that you are in good physical condition." "Just so my team is short of a human shield." "Kneel down and apologize to Feifei. I can consider giving you a chance to be cannon fodder." The surrounding students were so scared that they backed away.This is a second-level powerhouse!In this stage when the myth is just recovering, the second level is synonymous with invincibility.That is comparable to the strength of a newly awakened agent!The smile on Qin Feifei's face became even brighter.She snuggled next to Zhao Lingfeng and looked at Xia Wanqing with a victor's attitude."Did you hear that?" "This is a gift from Mr. Zhao." "Don't expect your illusory Chinese gods. Kneel down and beg for mercy, and maybe you can still live like a human being." Xia Wanqing's body was trembling.She wanted to do something.Even if she couldn't beat him, even if he died, she would beat that stinky face to pieces.Just when she was about to rush forward and fight for her life.A hand pressed down on her shoulder.That hand was cold and had no strength, but it firmly suppressed her volcano that was about to erupt."Don't rush to die." Ye Lin's voice sounded in her ears.It's plain and lazy, but it gives Xia Wanqing a strange soothing power."It's not worth it for this kind of garbage." Ye Lin took out a crumpled notebook from his pocket.It was the scribbling notebook he used to kill time when he was on duty in Pantaoyuan.There's still a little bit of fried dough stick residue on it that hasn't been wiped off.He put the notebook into Xia Wanqing's hand."Take it." Ye Lin stood in front of Xia Wanqing, blocking Zhao Lingfeng's aggressive sight.He didn't even look at Zhao Lingfeng."What is this?" Xia Wanqing was stunned."A cheat code for a game called life."
